title: Nothing CMF Watch 2 Pro Blue/Orange US$29.46 (~A$41.47), Dark Grey US$32.35 (~A$45.54) Delivered @ Nothing Online AliExpress
body:
Deal: Nothing CMF Watch 2 Pro Blue/Orange US$29.46 (~A$41.47), Dark Grey US$32.35 (~A$45.54) Delivered @ Nothing Online AliExpress

[adrianhughes1998] Shocking reviews when it came out, I do wonder if it has gotten better with firmware updates though ….
[MasterScythe] Not for the health features, well, not much. its just a step above 'basic' as the sensor is decidedly midrange. But at that price? Ive always felt people expect the world.
However using both the 2 and 3 with gadgetbridge and breezyweather has been a flawless experience.
[Toxinor] Very basic. limited watch faces options.
but it's cheap.
[kingmoron] Looks like it can't do basic intervals for running ? Looking st something cheap for my 8yo
[koplik88] Look at Amazfit. I got a cheaper one and it was still better & more features than the Garmin Forerunner
[Scramble] Can't go wrong with the Xiaomi Band 10. It would be a good size for the lad too
[adrianhughes1998] I can only get it to come to $38.50 USD?
[adrianhughes1998] thanks, managed to get it working finally down to USD 27
[hollykryten] Yes i think you at first forgot to apply the AUNS06 coupon which adds the another $9 AUD off.
[hollykryten] Mine came to $44.88 AUD delivered. I guess i got a good deal. I had the currency set to $AUD and paid through the credit card option. So i think if you select $AUD in your profile instead of $USD then you get a slightly better price. By the looks according to my bank transaction history the payment is processed in Australia (NORTH SYD) when you have the payment set to $AUD. So you get a better currency conversion rate price.
So setting the currency to $USD in fact doesn't get you a better price. Aliexpress has an Australian payment processor so they can deal in $AUD.
[hollykryten] It turns out i had ordered the blue colour model by accident. Some how thinking i had bought the dark grey and so thinking that i got a better price than what this deal title showed for the dark grey. Oh no.
Had to cancel the order and reorder the correct dark grey model which came to $49.09 AUD delivered (i mistakenly still had $AUD selected in profile). $49.09 AUD delivered is still a bargain. I mean it's $119 at JB so i'm not complaining.
[TerryTightwad] It usually does work out better in USD. It might just be working in AUD favor right now.
[TerryTightwad] It was actually beneficial to pay with AUD for a bit, for some reason. I never pay in AUD but calculated it cheaper tonight.
[biznis] for us$25 more you can get the newer 3 pro, which i just did the other day
[hollykryten] Is the 3 pro really that much better than the 2 pro?. All i'm going to be using my 2 pro for is knowing what the time is as in using as an actual time watch. I care nothing for these fitness features.
And i had a look at the 3 pro first and the first coupon code isn't eligible from the listing for it. https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005009630357064.html?spm=a2…
The second coupon however worked for the $6 USD off. But the price comes to $65.02 USD ($90.77 AUD) for the 3 pro dark grey which is about double the price that you can get the 2 pro for from this deal.
Any way in my opinion going by the photos of it the watch looks way too big and so kind of tacky.
[biznis] for what you need it for, 2 pro is perfectly fine i would say
[TerryTightwad] Seems like a great deal. Was tempted but seems to have similar features to the Redmi 5 active I already have, wonder if its any upgrade apart from more premium look, amoled and gps which I probably dont need.
